Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
"While Slag is ready, any Methuselah playing or discarding a card during a
referendum must show you the card drawn to replace it."

Two quick questions about this ability:

1) Does this include cards discarded to a tapped Barrens, etc, during the
referendum? (I assume "yes", there's really no other way to read it, but
I am just checking).

2) If someone plays a Wake with Evening's Freshness during the referendum,
does Slag's controller get to see the card they draw during their next
untap phase to replace it?

Thank you.
